theft_theses.title: Fake PermitC substitution for token theft
theft_theses.evidence: Handler-level bypass possible (MaliciousPermitC returns success without transferring), but AMM's balanceInBefore + amountIn == balanceInAfter check blocks actual theft.

theft_theses.title: ERC-1271 cosigner bypass for unauthorized swap execution
theft_theses.evidence: Cosigner address is embedded in the signed additionalDataHash. Permit signer must commit to the cosigner — a malicious ERC-1271 cosigner only works if the signer chose it.

theft_theses.title: CLOB rounding extraction via afterSwapRefund
theft_theses.evidence: calculateFixedInput rounds UP (maker-favorable) but max 2 wei per fill. Accounting exact by construction: SUM(stepOutput_i) + fillOutputRemaining == amountOut. InsufficientOutputToFill revert guard prevents overflow.

hypothesis_results.detail: Fake PermitC token theft: handler-level bypass possible but AMM balance check (balanceInBefore + amountIn == balanceInAfter) blocks actual theft. See FP-P02.

additionalDataHash field omissions: feeOnTop unsigned is intentional (FP-SUB08). permitProcessor not in EIP-712 signed data but PermitC domain separator prevents cross-processor replay. AMM balance check is backstop.
Cosigner nonce=0 replay: REUSABLE_COSIGNATURE_NONCE=0 is explicit opt-in by design. Signer chose cosigner with nonce=0, accepting reusability.
Partial fill rounding bypass: FullMath.mulDiv rounds DOWN (protects signer). Zero denominators revert. maxAmountIn calculation is conservative.
CLOB linked list corruption: nonReentrant modifier on all entry points. Linked list ops within single transactions.
ERC-1271 cosigner bypass: cosigner address is in the signed additionalDataHash. Signer must commit to the specific cosigner — self-inflicted.
calculateFixedInput overflow: FullMath.mulDivRoundingUp reverts (not wraps) on overflow. DoS at most, not value extraction.
afterSwapRefund rounding extraction: max 2 wei per fill. Exact accounting by construction. Revert guard prevents overflow. 10k fills = 20k wei, below gas costs.
directSwap vs singleSwap arbitrage: entirely different liquidity sources (transfer handler orders vs AMM pool reserves). No shared pool. No arbitrage path.
Cross-chain cosigner replay (CP-002): destroyCosigner uses universal domain (no chainId). Requires same cosigner on multiple chains + unused nonce + identical deployment. Self-inflicted.

architecture_observations: Three-layer defense: (1) handler checks, (2) hook validation, (3) AMM balance check backstop
EIP-712 SWAP_TYPEHASH covers 9 fields. feeOnTop and permitProcessor intentionally excluded.
Cosigner system: bitmap nonces, nonce=0 = reusable opt-in, destroyCosigner uses universal domain (CP-002)
CLOB accounting: exact by construction. calculateFixedInput rounds UP (maker-favorable, max 2 wei/fill)
Access control: all callbacks guarded by msg.sender == AMM. Registry by LibOwnership. CLOB user functions are caller-driven.
Reentrancy: nonReentrant on all CLOB entry points. Hook callbacks within AMM's nonReentrant scope.
